Vanna’s Unified Margin pools your positions to absorb volatility. A strict 1.1x floor, not 1.0x.

Built on testnet.

thread:
Why the 1.1x floor?

It provides a 10% safety buffer to absorb Reflector's ~5-minute oracle latency and market slippage.

No sudden liquidations. 0% liquidation fees on testnet.
